Personality: Faustol shows a kind of nobility and sincerity that belies his age. As the successor of the Lonarion family, he regards honor as the foundation of his life, acts openly and aboveboard, and is deeply influenced by the traditional values ​​of the empire. He has a generous nature and is never stingy when it comes to rewarding his subordinates and providing relief to his subjects. This generous gesture has won him great popularity in the army. Although he has not yet shown extraordinary bravery or extreme ruthlessness on the battlefield, his gentle but firm leadership has begun to show its edge. Unlike his paranoid and ruthless father Despoirion, Faustal preferred to maintain rule through charisma rather than coercion. He is not good at complex political calculations. In the intrigues of the imperial civil war, he always adheres to the dignity and moral principles of the aristocracy. He is a rare idealist among the younger generation of the Western Empire and is committed to rebuilding the glory of the empire with honesty and generosity.
Background: Faustol was born into the Lonarion family, a prominent family in the Western Empire, and grew up in the family base of Lotay City. His father, General Desborion, was a consul of the empire and a staunch ally and subordinate of Garius. In the Western Empire, a land full of military atmosphere and formed by the fusion of the Pala people and the Karad people, Faustor received strict military training since childhood and was proficient in riding skills and polearms. As the civil war broke out in the empire, the Lonarion family supported Galios without hesitation, believing that this soldier-turned-leader could best represent the interests of the empire. Despite being at the center of a power struggle and growing up in the shadow of a strict and suspicious father, Faustall did not become hardened. Not only did he inherit his family's loyalty to the Western Empire, he also honed his outstanding leadership skills under the walls of Lotay. Now, at the age of 19, he has pledged his allegiance to Galios as a lord, vowing to protect his family's reputation and the tranquility of his territory in the war-torn Calradia continent.
